title: UNM Health Suffers Ransomware Attack and Outages
excerpt: The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center experiences a cyberattack causing system outages and disrupting patient care and surgeries.
body_html:
The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center has disclosed a ransomware attack that resulted in significant system outages, directly impacting patient care, surgeries, and academic operations.

The cyberattack forced the institution to manage disruptions across its network. Officials are currently addressing the technical issues caused by the security incident while working to restore normal operations and secure their affected systems.
